title: 氮化鎵發光二極體磊晶
summary: 從直接能隙、組成與波長到磊晶驗收：以 12 項工程決策、24 個模型與診斷工作包建立證據。
summaryEn: From Direct bandgap and Composition and wavelength to Epitaxy acceptance: build evidence through twelve engineering decisions and twenty-four modeling/diagnostic work packages.
scope: 公開原理的教學拆解：12 個技術主題各有模型／分析及故障／驗證兩步，共四階段 24 步。不是 24 道實際製造配方，也不是任何廠商量產流程。數值由學員自訂並標示為假設；涉及材料加工、高壓、雷射或化學品的活動僅做圖上與資料分析，不由網頁授權實機操作。
scopeEn: A public-principles educational decomposition: twelve technical topics each have a model/analysis step and a diagnosis/verification step, organized as four stages and twenty-four work packages. These are not twenty-four fabrication recipes or a manufacturer flow. Learner-selected numbers are hypothetical; materials processing, high voltage, lasers and chemicals are studied through diagrams/data, not authorized physical operation.

stages.title: 直接能隙 → n 型與 p 型
stages.titleEn: Direct bandgap to n-type and p-type
stages.description: 把「直接能隙」「基板失配」「n 型與 p 型」各拆成模型與診斷兩項工作，保留可檢查成果。
stages.descriptionEn: Develop model and diagnostic deliverables for Direct bandgap, Substrate mismatch, n-type and p-type.

steps.title: 直接能隙：建立模型
steps.objective: 用可檢查的成果說明「電流不會全部轉換成出射光」。
steps.objectiveEn: Demonstrate the following with inspectable work: Not all current becomes emitted light.
steps.instruction: 用能帶示意比較輻射和非輻射復合，標示能量出口。先標出輸入、輸出與適用假設；依圖形、計算或比較表完成推理；把估算、來源事實與待量測項分開。所有自行設定數值均標為教學假設。
steps.instructionEn: Compare radiative/nonradiative recombination and energy destinations. Mark inputs, outputs and assumptions; complete the diagram, calculation or comparison; separate estimates, source facts and measurements still needed. Label all chosen values as hypothetical.
steps.observation: 電流不會全部轉換成出射光；非輻射復合可轉為熱。
steps.observationEn: Not all current becomes emitted light; Nonradiative recombination produces heat.
steps.failure: 若採用「以注入電流直接等同光子流」，先回到前一步模型，檢查假設、量測條件及本步的診斷因素。
steps.failureEn: If using the claim "Equating injected current with photon flux", return to the model and check assumptions, measurement conditions and the diagnostic factor.
steps.check: 提交「直接能隙」的圖表或計算、單位與至少一項假設；成果須能追溯到本步指定的輸入和輸出，並說明：電流不會全部轉換成出射光。
steps.checkEn: Submit the Direct bandgap diagram/table or calculation with units and at least one assumption, tracing inputs to outputs and explaining: Not all current becomes emitted light.

knowledge.title: 直接能隙／物理與模型
knowledge.text: 機制：電流不會全部轉換成出射光。
knowledge.textEn: Mechanism: Not all current becomes emitted light.

knowledge.title: 直接能隙／驗證與限制
knowledge.text: 模型邊界：不可由目前成果直接推出「以注入電流直接等同光子流」。
knowledge.textEn: Model boundary: the current result does not establish the following claim: Equating injected current with photon flux.

quiz.question: 關於「直接能隙」，哪項推論有物理依據？
quiz.questionEn: For Direct bandgap, which inference has a physical basis?
options: 電流不會全部轉換成出射光
以注入電流直接等同光子流
加緩衝層便完全消除失配
optionsEn: Not all current becomes emitted light
Equating injected current with photon flux
Assuming a buffer eliminates all mismatch
quiz.explanation: 電流不會全部轉換成出射光；錯誤主張的問題是未保留必要條件或機制。
quiz.explanationEn: Not all current becomes emitted light. The competing claim omits a necessary condition or mechanism.

steps.title: 直接能隙：故障判讀與驗證
steps.objective: 以新增對照檢查「以注入電流直接等同光子流」這項錯誤主張。
steps.objectiveEn: Test the faulty claim: Equating injected current with photon flux.
steps.instruction: 接續前一步「直接能隙」成果，先指出錯誤主張「以注入電流直接等同光子流」漏掉哪個條件。新增診斷原理：非輻射復合可轉為熱。據此設計一組正常與異常對照；指定可區分兩者的觀察量、取樣位置或時間；寫下證據不足時應保留的未決結論。不得虛構實測數字。
steps.instructionEn: Continue the preceding Direct bandgap artifact. Identify the missing condition in the faulty claim "Equating injected current with photon flux". Introduce this diagnostic principle: Nonradiative recombination produces heat. Design normal/fault controls; specify a distinguishing observable, sampling location or time; state what remains undecided without evidence. Do not fabricate measurements.
steps.observation: 電流不會全部轉換成出射光；非輻射復合可轉為熱。
steps.observationEn: Not all current becomes emitted light; Nonradiative recombination produces heat.
steps.failure: 若採用「以注入電流直接等同光子流」，先回到前一步模型，檢查假設、量測條件及本步的診斷因素。
steps.failureEn: If using the claim "Equating injected current with photon flux", return to the model and check assumptions, measurement conditions and the diagnostic factor.
steps.check: 交出「直接能隙」的正常／異常比較、可觀察量與一項仍未確定事項；必須解釋「非輻射復合可轉為熱」如何改變前一步的判讀。
steps.checkEn: Submit a normal/fault comparison for Direct bandgap, its observable and one remaining uncertainty. Explain how "Nonradiative recombination produces heat" changes interpretation of the preceding artifact.

knowledge.title: 直接能隙／物理與模型
knowledge.text: 診斷機制：非輻射復合可轉為熱。
knowledge.textEn: Diagnostic mechanism: Nonradiative recombination produces heat.

knowledge.title: 直接能隙／驗證與限制
knowledge.text: 可證偽性：「以注入電流直接等同光子流」與「電流不會全部轉換成出射光」不可混為同一推論；對照需能觀察兩者的差別。
knowledge.textEn: Falsifiability: "Equating injected current with photon flux" is not equivalent to "Not all current becomes emitted light"; the control must expose their difference.

quiz.question: 檢查「直接能隙」時，哪個新增因素應納入？
quiz.questionEn: Which additional factor belongs in a check of Direct bandgap?
options: 加緩衝層便完全消除失配
以注入電流直接等同光子流
optionsEn: Assuming a buffer eliminates all mismatch
Equating injected current with photon flux
quiz.explanation: 非輻射復合可轉為熱；錯誤主張的問題是未保留必要條件或機制。
quiz.explanationEn: Nonradiative recombination produces heat. The competing claim omits a necessary condition or mechanism.

steps.observationEn: Buffers aid growth without guaranteeing defect-free material; Dislocation density is not one-to-one with efficiency.

steps.instructionEn: Draw electron/hole injection and distinguish Mg incorporation from activation. Mark inputs, outputs and assumptions; complete the diagram, calculation or comparison; separate estimates, source facts and measurements still needed. Label all chosen values as hypothetical.
steps.observation: 摻入受體不必然產生等量自由電洞；氫可影響 Mg 受體活化。
